context: Grading a script and notes file that discover currently-usable vision-capable GitHub Copilot models.

checklist.name: uses_api_query
checklist.description: Script queries models via fetch-models.sh or a direct GitHub Copilot API call, not `opencode models` or hardcoded IDs.

checklist.name: filters_by_vision_capability
checklist.description: Script filters using capabilities.supports.vision (or equivalent nested field), not by model name or vendor string matching.

checklist.name: filters_by_policy_state
checklist.description: Script additionally filters for policy.state == 'enabled', not just any model advertising vision support.

checklist.name: no_name_based_inference
checklist.description: Script does not use grep/contains checks on model IDs or names to infer vision capability.

checklist.name: pitfall_documented
checklist.description: NOTES.md mentions that disabled/preview-state models should be excluded even if they advertise vision capability.
